name: SS Conte Verde
builder: William Beardmore & Co., Dalmuir · yard no. 612
summary: A major Italian interwar liner built for Lloyd Sabaudo and later operated under Lloyd Triestino after the reorganization of Italian shipping in the early 1930s, she belonged to the generation of large Italian liners that carried emigrants, regular passengers, and symbolic prestige on routes linking Italy with South America and, later, Asia.
